confirmed_facts: Centralized retail finance. Each unit actually has associated bank accounts, but only HO staff can view/access/operate bank accounts; unit staff cannot. HO also has its own accounts.
Units handle physical sales cash, petty cash and cashier float. No direct unit-to-unit transactions.
After stripping E1 location suffix, baseline is 499 account families, including six non-E1 leaves.
We are evaluating ONLY removing bank institution/account identity within the 14 listed bank/deposit families. All other 485 families remain unchanged.
No transaction balances, actual account numbers, deposit maturities, restrictions, legal entity ownership or bank master provided. COA repetitions do not establish actual bank accounts.
